bear_assumptions: About USD 70 million of forward continuing-operations revenue at 1x enterprise value/revenue, USD 180 million of residual net financial resources and 75 million diluted shares as customer programs contract, autonomous-lab adoption remains slow, cash burn stays near guidance, and equity issuance continues.
base_assumptions: About USD 100 million of forward continuing-operations revenue at 3x enterprise value/revenue, USD 230 million of residual net financial resources and 70 million diluted shares as Nebula and tool offerings stabilize growth, restructuring lowers losses, but cash burn and stock compensation remain material.
bull_assumptions: About USD 140 million of forward continuing-operations revenue at 6x enterprise value/revenue, USD 280 million of residual net financial resources and 68 million diluted shares as autonomous-lab utilization, Datapoints and Solutions adoption accelerate, losses fall sharply, and dilution slows.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if fresh Q2 or later primary evidence and revised scenarios clear expected-return, base-upside, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin-of-safety, confidence, and accepted-relationship gates; downgrade if continuing revenue contracts further, autonomous-lab utilization or customer adoption stalls, cash burn exceeds guidance, restructuring savings fail to reduce losses, liquidity falls faster than modeled, or dilution materially offsets enterprise progress.
